overlap.comparison: Its common-core three-fiber theorem applies with B=C=K=T and E=0, giving raw depth at least Gamma_d V+a/2 at the same middle centroid. The new small-mass simplex result strengthens this to the exact maximum Gamma_d V+a and proves uniqueness.

Its local-star lower bound applies to one pair with two identical simplex large fibers for sufficiently small added mass. Its coefficient (Gamma_d+ceil((d+1)/2)/(d+1))/2 is below one, and it has no exact global maximum or uniqueness conclusion for these three fibers.

Its compatible three-fiber tilt model has the same coupled thresholds and proves general equalization properties. It does not establish the reflected-profile payment or the exact maximum for a contained small endpoint.

The obstruction uses a different equal-volume large partner, rather than the same simplex at both large fibers. It does not contradict the exact payment under the candidate's identical-simplex hypothesis.

Nonnegative mass on the small fiber cannot reduce that gap.
